newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Dec CPI rises 0.5 pct mo/mo, +8.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Czech Dec CPI rises 0.5 pct mo/mo, +8.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Czech consumer prices rose 0.5 percent in December putting prices 8.6 percent higher than in the same month of last year, the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) said on Thursday.
CZECH CONSUMER INFLATION Dec 96 Nov 96 Dec 95
DEC CPI BASKET COMPONENTS CHANGE MO/MO CHANGE YR/YR

Note. November basket component changes in brackets. All changes are rises except where stated. Prices have risen 22.2 percent from the average level for 1994 while the sliding average in December using a 1993 base was 8.8 percent. Basket of goods and services is unchanged from 1995.

The CSU said that the biggest influences on the December inflation rate were food, drinks and tobacco products which rose 0.9 percent in the month, lesiure time which rose 0.7 percent and clothing which rose by 0.6 percent. Together these three categories accounted for 80 percent of the overall inflation figure.
